description: Researchers from the Institute of Earth Environment and collaborating organisations reconstructed road networks on the Dongzhi tableland of the Chinese Loess Plateau for 1975–2020. The collection combines historical documents, field surveys, OpenStreetMap and image interpretation to represent road expansion. ScienceDB offers the vector data free under CC BY 4.0. The study area lies approximately between 35.26 and 36.07 degrees north and 107.45 and 107.97 degrees east. The inspected metadata does not establish the vector file format, road capacities or whether every junction is routable. The historical layers can support scenarios linking transport expansion to erosion and landscape change. They complement data-openstreetmap with earlier local road configurations, subject to checking topology and the dates represented by each layer.
name: A dataset of road network in the critical zone of the tableland area on the Loess Plateau from 1975 to 2020
